issues.title: Add checkout page — customer info, delivery, payment, order summary
issues.body:
## Summary
Built the checkout page (frontend) — customer information, delivery address, payment method selection (Mobile Money / Bank Transfer / Card), order summary, and order confirmation screen. Structured as checkout.html / checkout.css / checkout.js to match the project's cart/products pattern.

## Issue
Closes #4

## Changes
- Added src/frontend/checkout/checkout.html, checkout.css, checkout.js
- Client-side form validation for all required fields
- Order summary pulls cart items and calculates subtotal, delivery fee, and total
- Confirmation screen shown after successful submission

## Still pending
- Cart data currently uses placeholder/demo items — will connect to the real cart source once confirmed
- Order submission currently simulated (logs to console) — will connect to the real backend (Node/Express + PostgreSQL) once the API endpoint is ready

issues.title: Isuue#7
issues.body:
Objective

Build the Kay's Haven admin dashboard using React.

Tasks

- Create the admin dashboard layout and navigation.
- Create an admin login page.
- Create a product management page.
- Allow admins to add, edit, and delete products.
- Create an orders management page.
- Display order details and customer information.
- Allow admins to update order status.
- Display basic dashboard statistics such as products, orders, and customers.
- Make the admin interface responsive.
- Prepare the frontend for integration with the Node.js backend/API.

Acceptance Criteria

Admin dashboard is functional.
Product management interface works.
Orders can be viewed and managed.
Customer/order information can be viewed.
Order status can be updated.
Dashboard statistics are displayed.
React frontend is ready for backend integration.
Responsive on desktop and mobile.
Changes committed and pushed to the assigned branch.

issues.title: Issue#6 Payments, Contacts and Reviews
issues.body:
Tasks

* Integrate the selected payment gateway for **Mobile Money, Visa/Card, and other supported payment methods**.
* Handle and display **payment status** appropriately.
* Build the **Contact Us** section with WhatsApp, phone, and email contact options.
* Build the **customer reviews** feature.
* Add relevant **delivery information** for customers.
* Ensure payment and review functionality connects correctly with the backend/API where required.

issues.title: Backend & database
issues.body:
Tasks

* Build the **Node.js + Express backend/server**.
* Set up the **PostgreSQL database** for products, customers, orders, and order status.
* Create API endpoints for the frontend to send and retrieve data.
* Connect the backend to PostgreSQL and test saving/retrieving data.
* Document the database structure and API endpoints so the other team members can integrate their work.

issues.title: Issue#4 Checkout & Customer Orders
issues.body:
Build the checkout and customer order process for Kay’s Haven Online.

Tasks

* Create the checkout page.
* Create the customer information form.
* Collect:

  * Full name
  * Phone number
  * Email address
* Collect the delivery address and relevant delivery information.
* Display the order summary before submission.
* Display products, quantities, prices, delivery cost (if applicable), and total amount.
* Allow the customer to select a payment method.
* Validate required checkout information.
* Create an order confirmation page/message.
* Prepare the checkout data to be sent to the backend.
* Connect the checkout to the backend/API once the backend is available.
* Ensure the checkout works with the cart created in Task #3.
* Ensure the interface is responsive on mobile and desktop.

Expected outcome

A customer can proceed from their cart to checkout, enter their information and delivery details, review their order, select a payment method, submit the order, and receive an order confirmation.

Dependencies

This task depends on:

Task #3 — Product Details & Cart** for cart/order data.
Task #5 — Backend & Database** for saving orders.
Task #6 — Payments** for the actual payment integration.

The frontend checkout can be developed using temporary/mock data while those dependencies are being developed.

 Git workflow

Create a feature branch using:

`feature/4-checkout-orders`

Submit a Pull Request linked to this issue when the work is ready for review.

issues.title: Issue#3 Product Details & Cart
issues.body:
Build the individual product viewing and shopping cart functionality for Kay’s Haven Online.

Tasks
Create individual product detail pages/views.
Display product images, name, price, description, and other relevant details.
Support product sizes/variants where applicable.
Allow customers to select product quantity.
Add products to the shopping cart.
Allow customers to remove products from the cart.
Allow customers to increase/decrease quantities.
Update cart totals automatically.
Ensure the cart works with the product listings.
Prepare the cart data so it can later be used by the checkout process.
Use JavaScript where appropriate.
Ensure the functionality works responsively on mobile and desktop.
Expected outcome

Customers can select a product, view its details, add it to their cart, modify their cart, and see the correct order total before proceeding to checkout.

Git workflow

Create a feature branch using:

feature/3-product-details-cart

Submit a Pull Request linked to this issue when the work is ready for review.

issues.title: Isuue#2 Products & Categories
issues.body:
Build the product categories and product listing functionality for Kay’s Haven Online.

Tasks
Create the main product categories:
Baby
Toddler
Kids
Teens
Toys
Accessories
Back to School
Clearance
Create relevant subcategories where needed.
Build product listing sections/pages.
Add product images, names, prices, and descriptions.
Add category navigation.
Prepare the product data structure so it can later be connected to the backend/database.
Use JavaScript where appropriate.
Ensure the product listings work with the overall customer-facing frontend.
Expected outcome

Customers can browse products by category and view essential product information in a clear, responsive layout.

Git workflow

Create a feature branch using:

feature/2-products-categories

Submit a Pull Request linked to this issue when the work is ready for review.

issues.title: Issue#1 Homepage & Navigation
issues.body:
Build the customer-facing homepage and main navigation for Kay’s Haven Online.

Tasks

* Create the homepage layout.
* Build the header and navigation bar.
* Add the Kay’s Haven logo and slogan.
* Create the footer.
* Add featured products section.
* Add links to the main product categories.
* Ensure the overall layout is responsive on phones and computers.
* Use HTML, CSS, and JavaScript as appropriate.
*  Keep the implementation compatible with the rest of the customer-facing frontend.

Expected outcome

A responsive homepage that allows customers to easily navigate the Kay’s Haven Online store and access the main product categories.

Git workflow

Create a feature branch using:

`feature/<issue-number>-<short-description>`

For this issue:

`feature/1-homepage-navigation`

Submit a Pull Request linked to this issue when the work is ready for review.
